scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @karaokej/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @karaokej/api" "npm run dev -w @karaokej/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @karaokej/shared && npm run build -w @karaokej/web && npm run build -w @karaokej/api
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
